verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents a JSON data API, but the evidence states its endpoints carry no version segment. The deprecation fields in its schema cover the lifecycle of formulae, not the API surface, so there is no documented API versioning or API deprecation policy. Community comments on Intel support deprecation concern hardware support tiers, not API versioning, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
